crmf.title: Find clinics
crmf.lead: Bring in clinics' names, addresses, phones, websites and published e-mails from the free map or from Google Maps, then add them to the CRM.
crmf.key_missing: Optional: a Places API key to search Google from inside the system. Without it, use the free map or the Google Maps collector.
crmf.key_help: Create a key in Google Cloud and enable Places API (New) on it. Each search is billed to your Google account.
crmf.emails: Read the e-mail address from the clinic's website
crmf.new_search_sub: For example: dental clinic, dermatology centre, paediatrician. Google returns up to 60 places per search.
crmf.auto: Repeat daily and tell me about new clinics
crmf.searches_sub: A clinic that appears in a repeated search for the first time is marked "New on Google" — often a clinic that just opened.
crmf.delete_confirm: Delete this search? Its places not added to the CRM are removed.
crmf.ran: {found} places found: {added} new to the list, {fresh} on Google for the first time.
crmf.none: Nothing here. Start a new search, or upload a file from the Google Maps collector.
crmf.none_key: Add the Google Maps key first.
crmf.added: {places} clinics added, {contacts} of them as new contacts.
crmf.note: Data from Google Places and the clinics' public websites. Contact clinics in line with the privacy and marketing laws of their country, and respect anyone who asks not to be contacted.
crmf.source_help: The free map needs no key but needs the city, and in some cities it knows fewer clinics than Google. For full Google results without a key, use the Google Maps collector.
crmf.col_card: Runs in your browser on Google Maps: searches, goes through the results and saves names, phones and websites in a file you upload here. No key.
crmf.col_open: Open the collector and how to use it
crmf.col_lead: A button you add to your browser's bookmarks bar. Open Google Maps and press it: it searches what you type, goes through the results one by one and saves them in a CSV file you upload on the Find clinics page.
crmf.col_s1: Drag this button with the mouse to your browser's bookmarks bar:
crmf.col_s1_help: If the bookmarks bar is hidden, press Ctrl+Shift+B (⌘+Shift+B on a Mac).
crmf.col_s3: Press "Collect clinics" in the bookmarks bar, type what to search, one search per line (e.g. dental clinic Amman), then Start.
crmf.col_s4: Leave the page open until it finishes; the file is saved to your downloads. If Google asks you to verify, do it and press Start again.
crmf.col_s5: Upload the file under "Upload a list" on
crmf.col_drag: Drag this button to your browser's bookmarks bar, then press it while on Google Maps.
crmf.col_console: Or paste the code in the Console
crmf.col_console_sub: If the bookmark does not work: open Google Maps, press F12, then Console, paste the code and press Enter (Chrome may ask you to type allow pasting first).
crmf.col_note: The collector only reads the page open in your browser and sends nothing anywhere; it goes through results slowly, like a person. Keep searches to a reasonable number: Google may ask you to verify or stop heavy use.
crmf.import_sub: The file from the Google Maps collector, or any list with a name column (and phone, website, e-mail if you have them). From Excel: save as CSV UTF-8.
